Spooner Stainless Steel Flask Mug – 400ml Double-Walled Insulated Travel Mug

The Spooner Stainless Steel Flask Mug, Capacity: 400ml is designed for people who value convenience, durability, and temperature retention in their daily beverage routine. Whether you enjoy piping hot coffee during your morning commute or chilled drinks during long travel hours, this double-walled insulation flask mug ensures your beverages stay at the ideal temperature for a longer duration.

Built with premium-grade stainless steel, the Spooner flask mug offers excellent resistance to rust, corrosion, and everyday wear. The advanced double-walled insulation helps in maintaining the temperature of your beverages—keeps coffee hot or drinks cold for a longer duration, making it a reliable companion for office use, travel, gym sessions, or outdoor adventures.

Superior Double-Walled Insulation Performance

This 400ml stainless steel features vacuum-sealed double-wall insulation that minimizes heat transfer. Hot beverages like coffee, tea, or soup remain warm for hours, while cold drinks such as juice or water stay refreshingly cool even in warm conditions. The outer wall remains sweat-free and comfortable to hold, ensuring a pleasant user experience throughout the day.

Thanks to its efficient thermal insulation, the Spooner Stainless Steel helps reduce the need for reheating or refilling, saving both time and energy. It is an eco-friendly alternative to disposable cups, supporting sustainable and reusable drinkware choices.

Premium Stainless Steel Build

Crafted using high-quality food-grade stainless steel, this insulated is safe, hygienic, and odor-resistant. Unlike plastic mugs, it does not retain flavors or stains, ensuring every sip tastes fresh. The sturdy construction makes it suitable for daily use at home, in the office, or while traveling. With a compact 400ml capacity, the is perfectly sized to fit most car cup holders and backpack side pockets. Its lightweight yet durable design makes it easy to carry wherever you go.

Stylish Color Options

The Spooner Stainless Steel is available in colour: Black and White, offering a clean and modern look that suits every lifestyle. The matte finish adds a premium appearance while enhancing grip and scratch resistance.

Ideal for Everyday Use

Whether you are a coffee lover, a frequent traveler, or someone who enjoys hydrated living, this insulated travel is designed to meet your needs. Its versatility makes it suitable for hot coffee, tea, milk, cold water, smoothies, or energy drinks. The secure lid helps prevent spills, making it ideal for commuting and outdoor use.

  • Capacity: 400ml stainless steel flask mug
  • Double-walled insulation maintains beverage temperature
  • Keeps coffee hot and drinks cold for a longer duration
  • Made from premium food-grade stainless steel
  • Available in Black and White color options
  • Ideal for office, travel, gym, and outdoor use
  • Reusable, eco-friendly, and easy to clean

Why Choose?

The Capacity: 400ml combines performance, style, and durability in one practical solution. Its reliable insulation, premium materials, and modern design make it a smart choice for individuals and businesses looking for quality drinkware. Whether for personal use or gifting, this stainless steel delivers consistent performance you can trust. Upgrade your daily beverage experience with a that keeps up with your lifestyle—choose Spooner for lasting temperature control and timeless design.
